about_the_game:
Tap into the tension of fighting games with Longjuice Squeeze, blending roguelite and extraction elements with seriously ridiculous taste. Battle through 1v1 duels to overcome opponents, collect new gear, and compete for a spot among the juiciest fermentationists.

Progress through the game by winning duels, experimenting with builds, and enhancing your won items. Completing 100 Flavor Rite fights will squash your homunculus into a delicious longjuice prepared especially for the Lord Alchemist’s Royal Tasting. Overcome your opponents, monitor your longjuice flavor, and manage your equipment in this quest for greatness.

Duel against bots or other players in matches where losing means relinquishing a core piece of your build to your opponent. As you collect new upgrades, discover new synergies to enhance a current kit or develop a new combination. Turn your bloodgun into a deathray or add poking distance to your sword, each relying on different drops from your opponent.

 

Experience strategic combat with Longjuice Squeeze’s unique fighting system. Reload your bloodgun by landing hits with your sword, parry oncoming bullets, and dash through the air and across the ground. Between rounds, equip new upgrade combinations to enhance your core skills and stats.

 

Begin your ascension to greatness in the Flavor Rites and take your homunculus from zero to hero… then bottle it for consumption. As a fermentationist, you share the singular goal of all great longjuicers: recognition among the Royal Fermentationists. For your little guy to earn a spot among the greats, they must find their place among the best longjuice in the realm, worthy enough for the lips of the Lord Alchemist himself…or die trying.

  • PVP fighter with roguelite and extraction elements

  • Tight, streamlined controls, including online multiplayer with rollback netcode

  • Over a thousand unique builds across dozens of items, additives, and infusions

  • Set in an absurd and vibrant new world

  • Original, genre-bending soundtrack

short_description: Shoot, parry, and slash your way to self-awareness in Longjuice Squeeze, a roguelite extraction fighting game where you get to steal gear from your opponent when you win! Featuring highly customizable fighters, tons of collectable gear and rollback netcode.
